ruler.note: no published size; woman beside the clock in ref/05 (302 px, ~12 % closer than the clock -> 270 px at clock depth) => 6.2 mm/px in ref/05; ref/04 is 1.39x larger (ball-centre to ledge-top 841 vs 605 px) => 4.46 mm/px. Uncertainty ~±8 %; total height 5.59 m
